reviews.author: Michael Black
reviews.text: I usually like to work on my own stuff, and 99% of the time I can, but the 1% when I can't this is my goto spot. Jim, Mark, and Michael are all super knowledgeable, helpful, and fair when it comes to work. There's a reason they've been in business so long and it shows in the quality of work they do on your vehicle.

reviews.author: Jacob Hess
reviews.text: I brought my car in to get the brakes fixed at 8am when one of the employees said it would be done the same morning and said they would call to pick it up. A few hours pass and still no call 2:30pm I’m frustrated because I have to be to work in 15 minutes so I walk up there and they just got it done but when I got it back it had more problems than I brought it there with. I will not be returning to this shop. And I will never recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: Tina Rigdon
reviews.text: Great service! Great prices and I get my car back when promised. That means a lot when you have to borrow a vehicle until I get mine back. Jim the guys are wonderful!!!

reviews.author: Glenn Stanford
reviews.text: Great service at a fair price. Always honest and stands behind his work. Best place in Barnwell to have your car serviced. Always friendly and smiling!

reviews.author: Amber Padgett
reviews.text: Jim provided great work at an affordable price & was very good with making sure I knew exactly what he was doing to my car.

reviews.author: Chasity Schmidt
reviews.text: Will always take my cars here. He always gets right on them. Very pleasant to talk to about what is wrong. Always calls before replacing anything. With pricing

reviews.author: Brenda Anderson
reviews.text: It was great. Work done in a timely manner. 100 percent satisfied. Would recommend to anyone needing work done.

reviews.author: Amber “Trip” Hutto
reviews.text: Always has my size tires. I am a person to wait till the last minute to get a tire but they always help. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Charles Ferguson
reviews.text: NOT open on saturday.But hrs was there and checked a tire for me anyways.The man did what others don't care about HE TREATED ME WITH RESPECT and I had no n for repair.AWESOMENESS
